properties.label_detail_en: Nuba Mountains kingdom, semi-autonomous after 1821 (HD2011). Taqali (Wikidata Q1111926) has no coordinate, so the Nuba Mountains centroid stands in. Founding c.1750 and end 1969 not verified. Point only; approximate edges not drawn (unsourced).
